Vava ʻ u is an island group, consisting of one large island ( ʻUtu Vavaʻu ) and 40 smaller ones, in Tonga . It is part of Vavaʻu District , which includes several other individual islands. Vava ʻ u rises 204   m (669   ft) above sea level at Mount Talau . The capital is Neiafu , situated at the Port of Refuge (Puatalefusi or Lolo- ʻ a-Halaevalu).
